description: Async proto-learning capture, shared by every automated loop in this repo. SubagentStop analyzes each finished subagent's transcript; SessionEnd analyzes the top-level loop session once at the end for loop-level learnings. Both run off the critical path — the hook is async and the analyzer is spawned detached, with the invoking session's inbound-message bindings stripped so it can never receive an event meant for the loop — matching on this ecosystem's shared conventions (github-ops, /goal) rather than naming individual loops, and append a row to the shared Slack canvas when something worth improving happened.
